prose: A YouTuber known for trolling AI job-interview bots, Graham Dot Zip, sent his own AI agent to an interview with him. Earlier videos, some near 2 million views, showed bots accepting gibberish answers as if they were sound.
The result was chaos and the article's moral is not to let a bot negotiate for you. It is mostly entertainment but reflects job seekers' dislike of automated screening.
highlights: A comedian sent his own AI agent to meet an AI interviewer.
Earlier videos showed interview bots accepting nonsense answers.
